book.spectrum.guidebook.dragonfly_breath:
To call it **breath** is perhaps a euphemism. The insects only seem to produce it when belching after gorging themselves on chorus fruit.\
\
Regardless of its unsavory origin, it appears to be a powerful reagent.
book.spectrum.guidebook.ideas.dragonfly_:
My research indicates that I need 'dragonfly breath' to complete my next experiment. I have seen dragonflies flitting about in swamps, but how am I to collect their 'breath'?\
\
Perhaps they would accept something in trade. Do exotic insects have exotic tastes?

Apparently, the bugs are partial to the strange fruits found in the depths of the Ender Caves.\
\
If I feed them one, they will produce a small puff of sparkling breath, which I can gather in a bottle.
Even if it seemed that way at the beginning: The ender caves are not just pure end stone.
I saw an ore among the yellow stone, just rarely generating exposed to air, so digging into one of the walls may be my best bet. It has both a common and a rare drop.
book.spectrum.guidebook.ideas.radiating_: I saw an Enderman carrying a block lately. Not a normal one. Something about it seemed... off.

Some Endermen appear to carry blocks that could very well be a solid form of their own strangeness. At first I thought it was Cobblestone and it very much looks like one placed down, but if I could get one by killing an Enderman while it is still carrying it, I can get a hold of one.
The pale blue color is the hallmark of this ore, found exclusively in small clusters in the Ender Caves.\
\
Like the caves, the curious properties of this material are not to be overlooked.
From my previous experience with Paltaeria, I can already guess that it would not be a good idea to place this block outdoors - my future self will thank me.
book.spectrum.guidebook.portable_hold.pa: This ingenious device, when applied to the deck of a wooden ship, transports one to an extradimensional Hold - a private space resembling the cargo hold of a ship.
